overview_description.description: Bites is an AI-powered learning platform designed to transform traditional study materials into interactive, personalized, and bite-sized learning experiences. Born out of the success of Shaguf, which empowered teachers and students through a thriving EdTech marketplace, we envisioned something even bigger. With Bites, we’ve expanded our mission to revolutionize learning for students worldwide, leveraging generative AI to make education smarter, more engaging, and tailored to today’s learners. Since its launch in August 2023, Bites has grown to over 1 million users, demonstrating the demand for a smarter, student-first approach to education.

product.name: Bites AI Study Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform that converts educational files into interactive study materials like flashcards and quizzes to facilitate learning and review.

product.name: Flashcards
product.description: Interactive digital cards with questions on one side and answers on the other to aid memorization and recall.

product.name: Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Tests
product.description: Tests composed of multiple-choice, true/false, and fill-in-the-blank questions to assess knowledge and understanding.

product.name: Summarization Tool
product.description: A tool that converts long educational content into concise, clear bullet points to aid focus and save study time.

product.name: Note-taking Feature
product.description: A feature that allows users to write, highlight, and organize notes directly on their study files within the platform.

product.name: Bito AI Assistant
product.description: An AI assistant that explains difficult concepts, answers questions, provides hints, and translates study materials.
